question: In which Olympic Games did Leander Paes win a bronze medal in tennis?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1996 Atlanta**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Leander Paes**, one of India's most celebrated tennis players, won the **bronze medal in tennis** at the **1996 Atlanta Olympics**.
 
• He achieved this feat in the **Men’s Singles Tennis** category, marking India's first individual Olympic medal since 1952.
 
• Paes defeated **Fernando Meligeni** of Brazil in the bronze medal match to secure his historic victory.
 
• This medal was a turning point in Indian sports, bringing tennis into the spotlight and inspiring future generations of athletes in the country.
 
• The 1996 Atlanta Olympics was held between **July 19 and August 4, 1996**, and Leander Paes's victory remains a memorable moment in Indian sports history.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Leander Paes Career Overview:**

 
 
• Leander Paes is known for his extraordinary tennis career, particularly in **doubles and mixed doubles**, where he has won numerous Grand Slam titles.
 
• Born on **June 17, 1973**, in Kolkata, India, Paes hails from a family with a strong sports background—his father, Vece Paes, was an Olympic hockey player, and his mother, Jennifer Paes, was a basketball player.
 
• Paes has represented India in **seven Olympic Games** from 1992 to 2016, an incredible achievement in itself.
 
 
 
• **Impact of the 1996 Bronze Medal:**
 
 
• Paes's bronze medal at Atlanta broke a 44-year drought for India, as the last individual Olympic medal for India was won by **K.D. Jadhav** in wrestling at the 1952 Helsinki Olympics.
 
• This victory was instrumental in inspiring the youth of India to pursue tennis and other individual sports.
 
 
 
• **Tennis at the Olympics:**
 
 
• Tennis was reintroduced as a full medal sport at the Olympics in **1988** after being discontinued in **1924**.
 
• The format includes singles and doubles events for men and women, as well as mixed doubles in recent years.
 
 
 
• **Other Indian Achievements in Tennis:**
 
 
• After Paes, several Indian tennis players, including **Mahesh Bhupathi** and **Sania Mirza**, have brought laurels to the country in various international tournaments.
 
• India has also performed well in tennis at the **Asian Games** and **Davis Cup**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Fernando Meligeni:** The Brazilian player whom Paes defeated in the bronze medal match was a strong contender and ranked higher than Paes at the time.
 
• **Significance of the Medal:** This was India's only medal at the 1996 Atlanta Olympics, highlighting its importance in the country's Olympic history.
 
• **Role of the Indian Government:** Paes's success prompted the Indian government to invest more in sports infrastructure and training programs for athletes.
